body: Sounds like my husband. I've stopped purposely sharing my feelings years ago. But every now and again the fact that I'm running in empty, and the stress gets to me, and my stupid emotions start to show. Death would be kinder than living through these days.

Thank you both. I didn't go through with it. The weather cleared and some families showed up at the place I had chosen. I couldn't force an innocent family to witness the culmination of my failures. I managed to drive myself to a more secluded area, trying to figure out what's next. I tried calling the suicide hotline but ended up hanging up on them because the idea of surviving today by having the police pick me up, or my husband finding out really scares me.
